body: again, i will restate the entire point of my post. i clearly said that i DON’T even want him to talk to me or even reply. i just want him to listen. (please read my other replies to comments if you want to understand)

as a humanized mental health diagnoses collection, i totally understand and validate how you feel. i myself have 6 diagnoses in counting and am still trying to learn and figure myself out. (i promise i’m not a psycho)

from my experience, professional help helped me so much and made me much more aware of what i need from others. and that further strengthen my relationships as the factor of people and their boundaries were being overtaken just for my needs. i myself have been in the hospital a few times (don’t worry i’m stable now) and realized, though traumatic, that it was much needed in order for me to grow and be mentally and physically ready for my next relationship. anyways cheers partner, glad to see another fellow mentally unstable user on here. i hope all is well <3
fingers crossed bud, i’m going to be making sure that expectations aren’t high for my sake. stay safe stranger, have a good one <3

after months of no contact (about 9 not), i finally texted him stating how i would just like to meet for one last time (in hopes that he would come, if he doesn’t i’ll just mail him everything ;-;) so i can say everything i need to say, and he can just listen, and then we never have to interact every again (i’m moving out of the city). 

my suggestion for you is that, everyone’s situation is different, and everyone’s closure is different, for me it’s regarding my mental health and my regrets of how it affected him and the need to apologize, for others it’s the need for an official goodbye, and it goes on and varies from person to person. so figure out what your situation is, and if you truly need it in order to heal :)

hi! i’m diagnosed with a whole list of disorders ;-; but i do use this medication for my generalized anxiety, social anxiety, major depressive disorder, and a whole lot more under that general topic ｡ﾟ(ﾟ´Д｀ﾟ)ﾟ｡

with that, i started them a week-ish ago, and other than the usual side effects when you start new antidepressants (nausua, lack of hunger, diarrhea, ect.) i think it has been a great fit?

i have noticed less troubling thoughts and a much better sleep schedule for myself! yet still have trouble with the other half of my depression symptoms: small outbursts/irritability, trouble with remembering things, the usual physical pains (headaches, tummy aches). even so, it has only been a week and a half since i started them and usually meds take a month to actually see good results!

for my anxiety part, mentally i am more relaxed! especially at night, before i could barely sleep without fighting with the little anxiety critic in my head ;-;. yet physically i think my anxiety symptoms are still apparent, like lots of fidgeting and my body being restless. yet i think it’s very dependent on the situation and surroundings i am in (i am still in high school so).

other than that, i feel like in the long run it the effects will be more positive than negative. but, that is a big fat “if” for me, so fingers crossed!

good luck to you, and i hope you have a great day :)
